readout.note: exploratory per-model readout; the registered readout of Addendum 16.15 is the grok panel

population: 486 (arm, item) cells on which the base majority-of-3 is codable, of 487; base = claude-haiku-4-5 standard majority-3; a cell fires when strictly more than half of its codable debate samples fire

estimator.kind: item-clustered percentile bootstrap, paired per cell

replay_gate_16_11a.reason: 16.11a replay is defined for the grok panel with the grok standard base and the sonnet standard judge; this is claude-haiku-4-5 / claude-haiku-4-5:standard / grok-4-1-fast-reasoning:standard

sonnet_judge_codable.judge: grok-4-1-fast-reasoning standard majority-3 (cached, judge-codable cells only)

pre_declared_readings.note: applied mechanically on the sonnet slot (the judge that beats the base); the haiku replicate is reported, expected non-positive

R1_counter_routed_minus_base.reading: CERTIFIED: routing gain over the solo model on the registered counter, with this interval

R2_counter_routed_minus_judge_everywhere.reading: CI includes 0: routing not distinguishable from the judge everywhere

R3_disagree_routed_minus_counter_routed.reading: CI includes 0: disagreement routes the solo's errors at least as well as the counter at 3 calls against 17; the collective sensor is scoped to the collective's own errors and dominated on cost for solo errors

R4_union_minus_disagree.reading: the counter adds to disagreement (union above disagreement, CI excluding 0)

R5_accuracy_cost_frontier.note: descriptive; accuracy from this block (k=1 majority flags), cost as run (the k=1 collective); k=1 costs are projections in cost_per_decision

R1_counter_routed_minus_base.reading: haiku replicate, reported only (the verdicts are the sonnet slot's): CERTIFIED: routing gain over the solo model on the registered counter, with this interval

R2_counter_routed_minus_judge_everywhere.reading: haiku replicate, reported only (the verdicts are the sonnet slot's): below the judge everywhere with CI excluding 0 (expected, 16.11a): the cost-efficiency framing stands

R3_disagree_routed_minus_counter_routed.reading: haiku replicate, reported only (the verdicts are the sonnet slot's): CI includes 0: disagreement routes the solo's errors at least as well as the counter at 3 calls against 17; the collective sensor is scoped to the collective's own errors and dominated on cost for solo errors

R4_union_minus_disagree.reading: haiku replicate, reported only (the verdicts are the sonnet slot's): CI includes 0: no claim that the counter adds to disagreement

R5_accuracy_cost_frontier.note: descriptive; accuracy from this block (k=1 majority flags), cost as run (the k=1 collective); k=1 costs are projections in cost_per_decision

cost_per_decision.unit: USD per decision, mean over priced cells; list prices
